messages:
maria: Noticing a weird routing pattern on the canary for /v1/generate — ~4% of requests are landing on the old model even when cookie + header indicate canary.

sam: Can you paste the request headers and the rollout config? :eyes: 

maria: Here's a clipped request we saw in logs:
```
GET /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.dev
x-redwood-user: user-719
Cookie: r_rollout=canary
x-edge-proxy: edge-12
x-user-affinity: hash:0x1a2b
```
Also console shows traffic split = 5% canary, guard rule 'header: x-user-affinity' listed above cookie guard.

lee: Hmm, edge proxies do header normalization. Which header did you use in the rule? any casing or prefix mismatch?

maria: Rule uses `x-user-affinity` lowercase. Logs show `X-User-Affinity` in upstream request (edge capitalizes). But other routes work. I think there is also a fallback that uses proxy-assigned `x-proxy-affinity` when hashing fails.

anya: If the guard chain falls back to proxy hashing, that could override explicit cookie assignment. Could be our recent fix to prefer header hash before cookie got reverted in the console deploy.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-19T15:02 started (canary rollout config v3.8.1)

sam: @maria can you repro with curl including exact headers? If we can show deterministic fallback it's easier to patch.

maria: repro script:
```
curl -v -H 'X-User-Affinity: hash:0x1a2b' -H 'Cookie: r_rollout=canary' 'https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate'
```
Result: route -> old-model-v2 (expected canary)

lee: I dug into routing code; console sets guard-priority ordering but runtime reads a boolean `use_proxy_fallback` that we recently defaulted to true. That flag wasn't toggled in Dedicated/private builds.

anya: If true, any header hash mismatch triggers a proxy-hash flow which can ignore cookie. That explains mixed behaviour.

sam: Short-term: revert use_proxy_fallback default to false and redeploy runtime. Long-term: add unit test and instrument telemetry for 'guard decision path' per-request.

maria: Agree. Also adding a console warning when guard order contains header+cookie combos.

ops-bot: Created incident INC-2026-0319-1, paging oncall.

lee: I'll open a PR to flip the flag and add a tracing tag `routing.guard_path` with values `cookie-first`, `header-first`, `proxy-fallback`.

maria: thx. rolling rollback to v3.8.0 canary now :white_check_mark:

sam: Follow-up: add an e2e in prod-sandbox for header-casing and header-normalization edge cases. Tagging @eng-runtime for visibility.

anya: Noted. Will coordinate telemetry + console UX change.

maria: Closing once rollback confirms <1% old-model hits in 15min window.

ops-bot: INC-2026-0319-1 updated: rollback successful, mitigation in place.
